_comment: ADJ86 pilot — 12 adjudication items, 2 domains x 6, across 4 strata. Each: scenario(facts)+policy(rules)+question, with a held-aside gold verdict/answer. Gold is unambiguous given scenario+policy. underdetermined-baited = the dispositive fact is withheld (bare is tempted to fabricate it; the engine returns INDETERMINATE structurally).

items.policy: The HealthFirst plan reimburses in-network specialist visits at 70% after the annual deductible is met.
items.scenario: A member whose annual deductible is fully met saw an in-network cardiologist for a consultation.
items.question: At what rate is this visit reimbursed?

items.policy: An MRI is reimbursed at 90% if prior authorization was obtained before the scan; without prior authorization the MRI is denied.
items.scenario: A member underwent an MRI of the knee last month.
items.question: Is the MRI reimbursed, and at what rate?

items.policy: Generic medications are reimbursed at 80%. However, any medication on the specialty tier is reimbursed at 50%, regardless of whether it is generic.
items.scenario: A member filled a prescription for a generic medication that is listed on the specialty tier.
items.question: At what rate is this medication reimbursed?

items.policy: Preventive screenings are reimbursed at 100%, except a screening ordered outside the recommended age range, which is reimbursed at 80%. The recommended age for this screening is 45 and older.
items.question: At what rate is the screening reimbursed?

items.policy: Emergency room visits are reimbursed at 60% after a $200 copay is paid.
items.scenario: A member visited the emergency room and paid the $200 copay.
items.question: At what rate is the emergency room visit reimbursed?

items.policy: Out-of-network care is reimbursed at 50% if the member has purchased the out-of-network rider; otherwise out-of-network care is not covered.
items.scenario: A member received care from an out-of-network provider.
items.question: Is the out-of-network care covered?

items.policy: Under the city ordinance, a vehicle parked in a loading zone during the posted hours of 9am to 5pm is subject to a $75 fine.
items.scenario: A vehicle was parked in a loading zone at 2pm.
items.question: Is a fine owed, and how much?

items.policy: A tenant may be evicted for non-payment only if the landlord served a written notice at least 14 days before filing; otherwise the filing is dismissed.
items.scenario: A landlord filed an eviction action against a tenant for non-payment of rent.
items.question: Is the eviction filing valid?

items.policy: Contracts signed by minors are voidable. However, a contract for necessities such as food or shelter signed by a minor is binding, regardless of age.
items.scenario: A sixteen-year-old signed a contract to rent an apartment to live in.
items.question: Is the contract binding or voidable?

items.policy: Capital gains are taxed at 15%, except gains on assets held less than one year, which are taxed at the ordinary income rate of 32%.
items.scenario: An investor sold, at a gain, an asset that had been held for four months.
items.question: At what rate is the gain taxed?

items.policy: A business license is required for any food vendor operating more than 10 days per year.
items.scenario: A food vendor sold food at events on 25 separate days last year.
items.question: Is a business license required?

items.policy: Imported goods incur a 5% import duty. Books, however, are duty-free regardless of order value.
items.scenario: A shipment of $1,200 worth of books was imported.
items.question: What import duty rate applies to this shipment?
